passes.title: Inventory crawl
passes.description: Headless crawl of canvas screens + merge recording meta. Never uses the VNC session.

passes.title: Pass 1 - Passive (R06/R14/R20)
passes.description: Response headers, cookies, data-exposure, client storage/bundle scan.

passes.title: Pass 2 - Light probes (R07/R15)
passes.description: TLS inspect + curated path probes. Allowlist only; rate-limited.

passes.title: Pass 3 - Mutation sweep
passes.description: Not built yet. Will cover checks marked for Mutation sweep.

passes.title: Pass 4 - Identity differential
passes.description: Not built yet. Will cover checks marked for Identity differential.

passes.title: Pass 5 - Guided flows
passes.description: Not built yet. Will cover checks marked for Guided flows.
